approveAndCall reaches an external call on a caller supplied contract address.
The external call invokes receiveApproval on the untrusted spender contract, allowing a callback into token state after the allowance is already set.
The invoked external contract can re-enter approveAndCall/transferFrom before the original call returns.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an unvalidated token address.
The allowance is written before the external call completes, so re-entrant reads observe inconsistent state.
